title: 权限不是对象属性，而是一次关系
coreProposition: Authority is a scoped current relationship, not a permanent attribute of an isolated object.

sanitizedPrompt: Create a sophisticated 16:9 editorial 3D conceptual illustration. In a bright ivory architectural space, two substantial regular rounded-rectangular links made of translucent cobalt-blue optical glass interlock into one compact relationship symbol. Each link has an even rectangular cross section, precise straight sides, modest consistent corner radii and fine polished silver bevels. One link is angled slightly forward and the other slightly back so the interlocking construction is physically readable. At their single contact, a small warm amber glass segment emphasizes the particular binding between the two distinct blue links. The joined pair occupies the central two-thirds of the wide frame, with a clean confident silhouette and equal visual weight for both links. Luminous cobalt refractions, pale floor reflection, bright soft daylight, restrained architectural depth, immaculate smooth surfaces, polished high-end technology editorial rendering. The image communicates a specific relationship through the joined forms themselves.
